title: Price Volatility Spike
scenario: Flag days where the price moved more than 2 standard deviations from the 30-day moving average.
tableSchema: stocks (tick_id INT, trade_date DATE, price NUMERIC)
hint: Calculate rolling mean and rolling stddev in one window.
correctQuery: SELECT tick_id, trade_date FROM (SELECT tick_id, trade_date, price, AVG(price) OVER(PARTITION BY tick_id ORDER BY trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as mu, STDDEV_SAMP(price) OVER(PARTITION BY tick_id ORDER BY trade_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as sigma FROM stocks) t WHERE ABS(price - mu) > 2 * sigma;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE stocks (tick_id INT, trade_date DATE, price NUMERIC);
